title: Skill
description: SKILL.md frontmatter of a portable (L3) skill: the Agent Skills core fields only (agentskills.io/specification, read 2026-10-13). Engine extensions (Claude Code's disable-model-invocation, context, hooks, paths, model; Codex's agents/openai.yaml sidecar) belong to adapters, never to an L3 skill. allowed-tools is rejected because its values are engine tool names.

name.description: 1-64 chars, lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, no leading or trailing hyphen; equals the directory name. Harness skills are gerund kebab-case (lint).

description.description: 1-1024 chars: what it does and when to use it. Harness convention: 'Use when ... Do not use for ...' (lint).

metadata.description: String-to-string map (the spec). The harness reads version, deprecated and layer.

deprecated.description: Present only when deprecated: the reason and the replacement skill.
